id.description: Stable key. Must equal the template's directory name.

category.description: One of the ids in categories.yaml.

icon.description: A built-in icon name. An icon.svg next to template.yaml takes precedence.

required_tools.description: What the agent may use. mcp.<entryKey>.<access> grants an MCP catalog entry's tools by access level: read_only (tools that only read), read_write (those and tools that change something, never ones that delete) or full (every tool). skill.<name> picks a skill obot already has, by its SKILL.md name. No repository URLs; templates never ship skills.
